coordinate_system: Screenshot pixels; x right, y down; no camera/slope calibration.
point_offsets: Each marker independently perturbed by -radius, 0, +radius on both axes; this is sensitivity analysis, not an accuracy or confidence interval.
media_retention: Temporary public-player viewing images deleted after inspection; only original annotations retained.
review_limits: Four paused frames from two sources visually inspected. A third-source playback attempt failed and yielded no measurements. Source speed unverified; no physical duration inferred.

samples.context: Exaggerated in-rigger carving drill, close frontal-oblique moving camera; not normal-turn reference.
limitations: Hip region obscured by clothing; proximal markers inferred.
Boot marker is not a visible anatomical ankle centre.
Wide-angle lens, foreshortening and camera roll are uncorrected.
Large sensitivity to marker placement, particularly on the bent leg.
Adjacent inspected frame at 9.136082 s was not annotated and is not an independent example.

samples.context: Basic parallel assessment candidate, frontal-oblique panning view; source rating is task-specific.
limitations: Small skier and loose clothing limit marker placement.
Pelvis-to-boots axis combines two legs; not a measured lower-leg or ski-edge angle.
Image vertical is not gravity or snow normal.

samples.context: A later position of the same basic-parallel candidate; not an independent skier or turn population.
limitations: Same camera and skier as PV02; observations are dependent.
Projection changes during panning and skier rotation.
No physical movement duration calculated from the player timestamps.
